explanation: `singleSub` is the library's own definition. It is built with `Classical.choose`: an element of the augmentation ideal chosen so that its image is `single g a - single 1 a`. The theorem says that at `g = 1` the chosen element is zero. All of its content lies in the library's definitions (`singleSub`, `ι_singleSub`, `augmentationι_injective`). The proof uses only those, plus the generic lemmas `sub_self` and `map_zero`. Mathlib has no lemma about this chosen element, so no Mathlib declaration carries this content.
